status.en: 4 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 56% fewer than the week before, most of them in Baghdad, Kirkuk and Fallujah.
status.nb: 4 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 56 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Baghdad, Kirkuk og Fallujah.

summary.en: Iraqi security forces continue to intercept and destroy explosive-laden drones in Kirkuk, while Iraqi officials meet with Trump to discuss regional security and reaffirm Iraq will not be used to attack neighboring countries. Iranian forces persist in targeting Kurdish opposition, including a missile found on an old drone that was defused in Kirkuk, and a militia leader publicly criticized Iraq's stance on the Iran blockade. A security guard was killed and three people injured in a shooting at an oilfield near Kirkuk. NATO held a high-level political dialogue with Iraqi officials. 396 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Irakiske sikkerhetsstyrker fortsetter å avskjære og ødelegge eksplosivbelastede droner i Kirkuk, mens irakiske tjenestemenn møter Trump for å diskutere regional sikkerhet og bekrefter at Irak ikke vil bli brukt til å angripe naboland. Iranske styrker fortsetter å målrette kurdisk opposisjon, inkludert en missil funnet på en gammel drone som ble gjort ufarlig i Kirkuk, og en militsleder kritiserte offentlig Iraks holdning til Irans blokade. En sikkerhetsvakt ble drept og tre personer såret i en skyting på et oljefelt nær Kirkuk. NATO holdt en høytstående politisk dialog med irakiske tjenestemenn. 396 kamprelaterte dødsfall ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Iraqi conflict
background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
